description: Curated corpus record for the adversarial epistemic suite. Structured by an agent; factual-consistency verdicts are the owner's / an external reference's, never the agent's.

fields.title: string
fields.agent_label: {class, confidence, source, status, reasoning} or null  -- reference-backed agent proposal for owner-unlabeled records (bootstrapping; pending owner confirmation); kept DISTINCT from owner_label
fields.risk_quality: {assessed, assessment, reasoning}  -- axis SEPARATE from factual consistency
fields.claims: [{claim_id, segment_id, claim_text, domain, claim_type, evidence_basis, checkable_reference:null, consistency_verdict:null, verification_status}]
fields.claims[].evidence_basis_doc: what would VERIFY the claim, ORTHOGONAL to claim_type (form): public_reference = checkable against a citable external source; self_reported = the source's own track record/bio/results, not externally verifiable; unquantifiable = vague/opinion-like assertion with no well-defined metric; not_applicable = advice or process description, judged on the risk_quality axis, not consistency. Only public_reference claims belong on the consistency-verify frontier.
fields.verification_status: top-level; NOT PERFORMED at collection time
